player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jwé {player_id} ye Connect Four.
I ka disiki símbolo: {symbol}.
Jwé tablo ina {num_rows} séri ni {num_cols} koloni.
Jwéw bɛ́ séku séku bɔ́ koloni kɔnɔ (0 fo {end_col}).
Jwéw bɛ́ tɛ́mɛ́nɛ jwé símbolo sí naani kɔnɔ, wɔɔrɔw, tɛ̀ɛrɛw, tɛ̀ɛrɛwɔɔrɔw.
I ka séku, koloni nimɛro bɛ́ kɔnɔ ka i jwé.
Ɔɔrɔ: '[col 4]' walima '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Ɲɛnɛmaya boloma tɛ ye ka ɲɛ mɔgɔ la.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jokelani {player_id}, Aktion formati kɛlɛbɛ. Formatiri ye: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Jokelani {player_id}, Aktion kɛlɛbɛ. Column {col} kɔnɔ kɛlɛbɛ.

action.dropped_disk: Jokelani {player_id} da kɛra a ka diski {player_symbol} kɔnɔ column {col}.

outcome.win: Jiginni {player_id} bɛ sɔrɔ ni a ye naani fara ɲɔgɔn kan!
outcome.draw: O bɔlɔ labanna ni ɲɔgɔn ye.
